💰 FinOps Pricing Model, Free Tier & CUDs

Billing Model: Provisioned or Serverless Capacity + Replicated Storage + I/O
Metered Units: GiB-month • vCPU/Node-hour • I/O operations
Free Tier: Standard Metering Pay-as-you-go with zero upfront license cost
Committed Use Discounts: 1Y (20–25% off) / 3Y (40–52% off) Spend Commitments on eligible engines
Key Cost Watchouts:
  • Multi-region vs single-region HA replication topology
  • Backup retention & point-in-time recovery log volume
  • Cross-region read replica network egress
